title: RemoveGeodo
description: Remove all amethyst geodes from the world.
body:
Geode Remover (No More Amethyst Geodes!) Tired of having your mining trips, underground bases, or cave explorations ruined by massive, obstructive Amethyst Geodes? Geode Remover completely disables the natural generation of amethyst geodes in your Minecraft worlds, giving you clean, uninterrupted subterranean landscapes.

🌟 Features Total Removal: Completely stops Amethyst Geodes from spawning anywhere in the Overworld.

Better Caves: Enjoy cleaner cave systems, perfect for building underground structures or straightforward mining.

Performance Friendly: Built entirely using modern, lightweight data-driven logic.

🚀 Compatibility & Versions This mod is available for multiple versions of Minecraft. Please make sure to download the correct file for your mod loader:

NeoForge: Available for Minecraft 1.21.1

Forge: Legacy versions supported (Check the files tab for your specific Minecraft version)

⚠️ Note: This mod removes geodes during world generation. It will not delete geodes from chunks that have already been generated and explored in existing worlds. For best results, use this mod when creating a New World!

🛠️ Modpacks You are totally free to include Geode Remover in any modpack on Mondrinth app! No special permission is required.(this mod is in CurseForge too)
